provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.limitations: Not executed by me; correctness is argued from the generator and archived solver. Like the native solver, it assumes objects never shrink: if an object got smaller, it is copied unchanged with only its offset applied. If both dimensions changed, the B shape is also reused. The generator never produces either case. If no valid panel period exists, the input is returned unchanged. The fixtures are consistent with the uniform rule; no contradictions were found.
